limitations: Two non-reference sensor sites, not city means; Da Nang modeled-only.
Missing and rejected values are retained; analysis uses accepted values only.
ERA5 and CAMS are retrospective model output, not operationally available features.
Correlations are unadjusted and serially dependent; no p-values or causal interpretation.
Full audited period explored. Reserve new data for a future untouched model holdout.

policy.analysis_quality: accepted only; source values/status and absent hours remain in the dataset
policy.daily_mean: Full 24-hour Vietnam date, at least 18 accepted hours; observed summaries retained for all dates
policy.lag_correlation: Pearson of finite pairs separated by exact elapsed hours, no gap filling, no confidence bands
policy.scope: Full audited window explored; no untouched modeling holdout is claimed

selection.alignment: PM [t,t+1h): instantaneous weather at t; preceding-hour totals/means at t+1h
selection.measurement_selection: Latest eligible revision before quality; no fallback
selection.model_selection: Within product/location/purpose, latest retrieved capture covering valid time before variable/quality selection; no fallback
selection.model_tie_break: retrieved_at, snapshot recorded_at, UUID; deterministic, not provider run order
selection.use: Retrospective screening only; thresholds are review prompts, not calibrated error detectors

policy.weather_association: Pairwise-complete Pearson per sensor, minimum 3 pairs, no p-values; raw wind direction excluded (circular)
policy.wind_sectors: 8 compass sectors, calm if wind speed <0.5 m/s; descriptive bins only

purpose: Phase 5 descriptive EDA; no inferential, causal or model-performance claims
